statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-75595 requires Netty server-side TLS ClientHello/SNI selection. The exact KELD deployment enables Keycloak HTTP only, configures no Keycloak HTTPS certificate or keystore, publishes no Keycloak port, and terminates public TLS at Caddy before forwarding plain HTTP to keycloak:8080. Changing any of those deployment facts invalidates this statement.

The exact KELD deployment fixes KC_DB to PostgreSQL and fixes KC_DB_URL to a jdbc:postgresql endpoint, so the bundled Microsoft SQL Server driver is not selected or executed. The image SBOM also contains the fixed 13.2.1.jre11 classifier while Trivy reports the normalized 13.2.1 coordinate. Changing the database backend or URL invalidates this statement.
